title: Kissed Resinous Malaysian Fish Curry
description: A romantic Malaysian dish featuring tamarind paste and a glassy-jelly texture, this curry is perfect for a special occasion. The resinous flavor is balanced by the freshness of the fish and the spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the curry powder, turmeric, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish pieces and cook until they are opaque and flake easily with a fork.
Add the tamarind paste and coconut milk, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the fish is cooked through.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the sauce has reached the desired consistency.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
